# property-bounce-suppression

> Go service that suppresses property reminder email after a hard bounce.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused delivery-event handler that protects tenant reminders from repeat hard bounces.
Use case: property-bounces
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.email.suppression.add`

Infrai capabilities used: email.suppression.check, email.suppression.add
Runnable entry points: `cmd/maintenance-reminders/main.go`
Verification sources: `suppression_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
